_comment: Shared test cases of the recipe-link food matching: core's food_words and match_key
(backend/app/domain/tip_recipes.py) and the app's port must give exactly these results. The file lives in
core (backend/tests/fixtures/recipes/food_words.json) and the app copies it byte for byte
match_key: [name, its match_key]. same_food: [name, other] with equal, non-empty food words. processed:
[processed or part, food] sharing a food word. apart: [name, other] sharing none. free_from: names with
no food words. names: every name above and the cross-check names (the collection's line and catalog
names, the eval's foods, upper-case and Unicode edge cases), each with its match_key (key) and sorted
food words (words). The case lists are written by hand; names is written by
backend/scripts/food_words_fixture.py from the code (--add a JSON list of names to add some). Rules:
the module docstring of tip_recipes. Synthetic data only.
